### 1 — Scene
A rice dish with yellow curry-style sauce, apparent chicken pieces and vegetables, plus a mixed salad and a small cup of dressing. Water contributes no calories. The wrapped item behind the salad has no visible contents, so I exclude it.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 26 cm diameter → **531 cm²**
- **Salad bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter → **314 cm²**
- **Dressing cup:** approximately 4 cm diameter → **12.6 cm²**

### 3 — Visible items
Rice, apparent chicken, cooked vegetables, yellow sauce, leafy greens, tomatoes, cucumber and an oil-based dressing. Any cooking oil is included in the sauce estimate rather than counted separately.

### 4–6 — Area, volume and weight
For the mixed dish, coverage is apportioned between ingredients to avoid counting the same area twice. Heights are average pile heights.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 45% of main plate | 239 × 1.5 = 359 ml | 0.8 | 287 |
| Chicken pieces | 15% | 80 × 1.2 = 96 ml | 0.95 | 91 |
| Cooked vegetables | 7% | 37 × 1.2 = 44 ml | 0.6 | 27 |
| Curry-style sauce | 8% | 42 × 0.65 = 28 ml | 1.0 | 28 |
| Leafy greens | 35% of salad bowl | 110 × 2.3 = 253 ml | 0.15 | 38 |
| Tomatoes | 15% | 47 × 1.4 = 66 ml | 0.6 | 40 |
| Cucumber | 10% | 31 × 1.0 = 31 ml | 0.6 | 19 |
| Dressing | 100% of cup | 12.6 × 2.5 = 32 ml | 1.0 | 32 |

**Coverage check:** main plate **75%**; salad bowl **60%**, allowing for its broad rim.

### 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal/100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Rice | 130 | 373 |
| Chicken | 170 | 155 |
| Cooked vegetables | 40 | 11 |
| Curry-style sauce | 100 | 28 |
| Leafy greens | 20 | 8 |
| Tomatoes | 18 | 7 |
| Cucumber | 15 | 3 |
| Oil-based dressing | 450 | 144 |

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **562 g and 729 kcal** is plausible: about 433 g on the main plate, 97 g of salad and 32 g of dressing. The sauce composition and dressing’s oil content are the largest energy uncertainties.
